snippet.title: Haloween II Launch Trailer | Halo Infinite
snippet.description:
Trick or treat…Haloween II is here! 🎃

To mark the frightful occasion, Survive the Undead returns along with some scary-good Squad Battle updates, a creature-feature of Haloween costumes in The Exchange, and more.

Brave all 20 tiers of the latest free Operation Pass to unearth the Dirgesinger armor set, a Gravemind’s grimace wrought patiently from flesh and bone and time. Upgrade to the Premium Pass to unlock the Flood-flinging Defiled Needler weapon model and the Corrupting Oil weapon coating.

Operation: Haloween II haunts Halo Infinite now through November 18 👻

Read more: https://aka.ms/HaloweenIILaunch
